builder@campus.edu.question: What is Amazon Bedrock?
builder@campus.edu.answer: Amazon Bedrock is a managed service for accessing foundation models via API. The AWS production RAG flow uses **Amazon S3** (document ingestion), **OpenSearch Serverless / Bedrock Knowledge Bases** (vector indexing), and Bedrock models for grounded generation with strict citations.

lakshmi22092006@gmail.com.answer: Amazon Bedrock is a managed service for accessing foundation models via API. The AWS production RAG flow uses **Amazon S3** (document ingestion), **OpenSearch Serverless / Bedrock Knowledge Bases** (vector indexing), and Bedrock models for grounded generation with strict citations.

papapc06@gmail.com.question: What are the hackathon rules?
papapc06@gmail.com.answer:
AWS Student Builder Hackathon Rules:
• **Teams**: 2–3 students per team (one submission per team).
• **Demo**: Local demo is accepted; live AWS deployment earns bonus credit.
• **Builder Center**: Every team must publish a project article.
• **AI Grounding**: Chat responses must ground in club docs with citations.

papapc06@gmail.com.question: How do I publish on Builder Center?
papapc06@gmail.com.answer:
To publish on AWS Builder Center:
1. Sign in at [builder.aws.com](https://builder.aws.com).
2. Choose **Create** → **Article**.
3. Add a title, summary, screenshots, and explain your AWS architecture (Cognito, SES, S3, API, Bedrock).
4. Add tags: `#aws-student-builders-groups`, `#buildonaws`, `#amazon-bedrock`, `#rag`.
